candidates.reason: Good scale and the circle-behind-can layering works, but the logo floats at an arbitrary x (~148px), aligned neither with the left-set headline nor with the centre. The CTA is pushed hard right and away from the left-aligned legal line, so the left edge is ragged and the bottom of the layout is lopsided.

The original banner is just shrunk into a thin strip across the middle of the story canvas, leaving roughly 80% of it as dead space. The logo, CTA and can are tiny, the legal text is illegible, and nothing has been rearranged for the vertical format.

The logo is shrunk to a near-illegible speck top-right, competing badly with the big headline. The oversized can dominates the layout. The CTA sits on the cropped bottom-left circle, and the tiny legal line is jammed beside the CTA on the same row, so the bottom grouping is muddled.

Clean centred stack (logo, headline, can, CTA) with a sensible top-to-bottom reading order. However, the can is undersized, leaving a large empty gap between the headline and the product. The left-aligned legal line breaks the centred axis, and the cropped circle crowds the logo at the top right.
